_comment: Stat structure (names + tiers only; the VALUES are runtime/save-game progression, not authored here). 'faculties' are the reading-self (tier 1); 'secondary' is the doing layer -- survival/craft that feeds the self (tier 2). 'buffs' stay empty: their effects are content-driven and defined alongside the quests that make them wanted (see docs/design/GAME-SYSTEMS.md). A buff entry, when added: {"id": "...", "faculty": "wonder|reason|perception", "max_level": 3}.

starting_levels._comment: The levels the pilgrim BEGINS with (stat name -> level). Everything else starts at 0. Placeholder while the EXP->faculty progression is unbuilt: perception 2 gives a visible starting glow (glowBrightness scales with Perception -- see config/formulas.json; at 0 the world is dark). Remove/retune once progression lands.

faculty_colors._comment: Hue per faculty for the observation display (a reading is tinted by which faculty saw it; its difficulty sets the brightness). RGB 0..1.
